fact_previews: The Unique Translations Portal aims to connect translators and people in need of translations.
The portal intends to eliminate high prices charged by translation agencies.
The project was initiated by OWMG.
The project was based in Toronto, Canada.
The funding goal for the project was $4,942.

fact_previews: There is an inadequate demand/supply case in the translation services market.
The lion's share of expenses for translation services is attributed to mark-ups from translation agencies.
Translators are usually compensated at a considerably lower level compared to the expenses charged by agencies.
A unique portal will automatically connect translators and clients, benefiting both sides.
Clients can post their projects for free on the portal.

fact_previews: The platform includes a reliable proprietary Escrow system that ensures mutual fairness and transparency between translators and clients.
Translators only get paid when clients approve their work, and the system ensures that clients have appropriate funds to pay for projects.
The platform features proprietary public forums for communication between translators and clients.
The platform includes a proprietary instant messaging system for both public and private communication between translators and clients.
Details discussed on the platform remain completely confidential, which is difficult to ensure with third-party providers' platforms.

fact_previews: The project aims to provide essential translation services to individuals who cannot afford traditional translation agencies.
The project team has been working on making the translation technology real for a while.
The only risk anticipated by the project team is not being able to secure enough funding within a month.
The project team expresses optimism about the outcome of their efforts.
The project is hosted on Kickstarter.
